title: Wescraft: Progressive Worldborder
description: This mod adds reward token that are used to expand the worldborder upon use
body:
**Wescraft: Progressive Worldborder** is a mod from the **Wescraft Project** that changes the way the **worldborder** is controlled by adding **custom tokens** that the player can submit to expand the border.

### How does the border expand?

The **border's max size**, **starting size**, and **speed**, as well as the **max amount of tokens** are configurable. Using these values, along with the **amount of players** in the world, you can expand the border with even increments. The total amount of tokens possible between all players determines the increment value.

### How can players get tokens?

Well, that is up to the server host. This mod is meant to be a **base** and to be used with other mods that provide a way to get tokens, like **_KubeJS_** and **_FTBQuests_**. !!**_Using this mod alone will leave players with no way to get tokens._**!!

Visit the **discord server** to report bugs or suggestions!
